description: Shortcut from product feed items to a checkout: send feed item ids (tanatasa-variant-<id>) and quantities. Guests call create_cart first and pass its guest_token. Item names and prices you send are ignored; Tanatasa's catalogue is authoritative. Returns a checkout and review link; continue with set_checkout_details and prepare_payment.

checkout_session.description: The items to buy: up to 20 feed items with quantities.

id.description: The product feed item id, tanatasa-variant-<variant_id>.

guest_token.description: Private guest session token from create_cart. Retain for cart, checkout and purchase-status calls; no account login needed.

idempotency_key.description: A new random key per purchase; retry with the same key.

name: checkout_session
